journey.name: spark transfer to spending
journey.description:
Verifies the transfer to spending flow on Spark. With Spark ready, the Spending suggestion card opens the "Spending Balance" intro once, then Funding, which lists "Transfer from Savings" (testTag "FundTransfer"), "Transfer from HW wallet" (testTag "FundHardware"), "Use other wallet" (testTag "FundReceive") and "Manual setup" (testTag "FundManual"), in that order, with no Learn More button. Transfer from Savings opens the "Transfer to spending" intro once, then the amount screen (testTag "SpendingAmount"). The confirm screen shows "Network fees", "Service fees", "To spending" and "Total", and the Fast and Normal rows: Fast's fee is marked "max" and Normal's "est", and picking a row updates the Service fees and To spending tiles. Learn more explains the Fast and Later transfer speeds and the spending balance. Whether the provider offers a fast transfer needs a real deposit Spark sees, so this journey stops before the swipe; the states after it are covered by SettingUpScreen previews and SparkRepoTest.
Precondition: dev build with Spark connected on its regtest (no key needed), on a chain Spark and Savings share: either hosted regtest with `ESPLORA_URL` on Spark's chain through `scripts/spark-regtest-esplora.py`, or bitkit-docker's local `./spark` stack, built and forwarded as in `.claude/plugins/spark-regtest/skills/spark-regtest/SKILL.md` ("Local `./spark` stack"), with the node on the default local Electrum. On any other chain setup Funding disables the Savings and HW wallet transfers, and Transfer To Spending opens the Transfer Unavailable sheet. Also a freshly onboarded wallet (so neither intro has been seen) with a positive on-chain Savings balance and no channels, and the Spending suggestion card on Home. Start on the wallet home screen.

actions.action: Tap the Spending suggestion card and verify the "Spending Balance" intro opens; tap "Get Started" (testTag "TransferIntro-button")

Verify "Transfer from Savings" (testTag "FundTransfer"), "Transfer from HW wallet" (testTag "FundHardware"), "Use other wallet" (testTag "FundReceive") and "Manual setup" (testTag "FundManual") are listed in that order and enabled, with no "Learn More" button (testTag "FundLearnMore")
Tap "Transfer from Savings" and verify the "Transfer to spending" intro opens; tap "Get Started" (testTag "SpendingIntro-button")
Verify the amount screen (testTag "SpendingAmount") opens and wait until the available amount (testTag "SpendingAmountAvailable") shows a positive value
Tap "25%" (testTag "SpendingAmountQuarter") and verify the amount is a quarter of the available amount; tap "Max" (testTag "SpendingAmountMax") and verify it equals the available amount

Tap "Continue" (testTag "SpendingAmountContinue") and verify the confirm screen shows "Network fees", "Service fees", "To spending" and "Total", with "Fast" (testTag "SpendingConfirmInstant") selected, its fee marked "max", and "Normal" (testTag "SpendingConfirmLater") below it, its fee marked "est"
Verify "Service fees" equals the Fast row's fee, and "To spending" equals the amount less that fee
Tap "Normal" and verify "Service fees" shows the Normal row's fee and "To spending" grows by the difference, while "Network fees" and "Total" stay the same
Tap the fees (testTag "SpendingConfirmFees") and verify every amount on the screen switches to the local currency; tap them again and verify they switch back to bitcoin
Tap "Learn More" (testTag "SpendingConfirmMore"), verify the screen explains the Fast and Later transfer speeds and the spending balance, then tap "Understood" (testTag "LiquidityContinue")
Verify the confirm screen still shows Normal selected

Tap the fees (testTag "SpendingConfirmFees") so the amounts show the local currency, go back to the amount screen and verify the amount (testTag "SpendingAmountNumberField") shows in the local currency; tap delete (testTag "NRemove") and verify the amount loses its last typed digit in the local currency (50.00 becomes 50.0) with no maximum toast
Tap the unit button (testTag "SpendingNumberPadUnit") to switch back to bitcoin; go back to the wallet home
Tap the Savings balance card (testTag "ActivitySavings"), tap "Transfer To Spending" (testTag "TransferToSpending") and verify the amount screen opens directly, with no intro
